text.p: These are the leading stories in the Angola press on Thursday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- The Political, Defence and Security Council for the Southern African Development Community (SADC) decided at a meeting in Luanda to send five ministers to New York to present the region's position on Angola's peace process.
- Angolan president Jose Eduardo dos Santos told the SADC meeting that Angola was at a dangerous crossroad between war and peace.
- Angola and Portugal are due to sign a military accord on Thursday.
- The United Nation's peace negotiator in Angola, Alioune Blondin Beye, has left Luanda for New York to present to the U.N. Security Council his views on the peace process in Angola.
